segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func placeSubviews( in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout Void ) { guard !subviews.isEmpty else { return } let maxSize = maxSize(subviews: subviews) let spacing = spacing(subviews: subviews) let placementProposal = ProposedViewSize(width: maxSize.width, height: maxSize.height) var nextX = bounds.minX + maxSize.width / 2 for index in subviews.indices { subviews[index].place( at: CGPoint(x: nextX, y: bounds.midY), anchor: .center, proposal: placementProposal) nextX += maxSize.width + spacing[index] } } ```
